name: KIDS First OFC SV count summary per person
description: Returns median, min, and max SV counts per KIDS First sample for total SVs, DEL, DUP, INS, INV, and SVs longer than 50 bp. Uses phenotype_svs. To filter by race, add a condition such as AND LOWER(p.race) = LOWER('African') inside the WHERE clause.
query:
WITH per_sample_counts AS (
    SELECT
        p.bam_id AS sample,
        COUNT(ps.id) AS total_structural_variants,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN ps.type = 'DEL' THEN 1 END) AS deletion,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN ps.type = 'DUP' THEN 1 END) AS duplication,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN ps.type = 'INS' THEN 1 END) AS insertion,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN ps.type = 'INV' THEN 1 END) AS inversion,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN CAST(ps.length AS INTEGER) > 50 THEN 1 END) AS structural_variants_gt_50bp
    FROM phenotype AS p
    LEFT JOIN phenotype_svs AS ps
        ON ps.sample = p.bam_id
    WHERE 1 = 1
    GROUP BY p.bam_id
),
long_counts AS (
    SELECT 'Total structural variants' AS metric, total_structural_variants AS sv_count FROM per_sample_counts
    UNION ALL SELECT 'Deletion', deletion FROM per_sample_counts
    UNION ALL SELECT 'Duplication', duplication FROM per_sample_counts
    UNION ALL SELECT 'Insertion', insertion FROM per_sample_counts
    UNION ALL SELECT 'Inversion', inversion FROM per_sample_counts
    UNION ALL SELECT 'Structural variants > 50 bp', structural_variants_gt_50bp FROM per_sample_counts
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        metric,
        sv_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY metric ORDER BY sv_count) AS rn,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY metric) AS cnt
    FROM long_counts
)
SELECT
    metric,
    ROUND(AVG(sv_count), 3) AS median,
    MIN(sv_count) AS min,
    MAX(sv_count) AS max
FROM ranked
WHERE rn IN ((cnt + 1) / 2, (cnt + 2) / 2)
GROUP BY metric
ORDER BY
    CASE metric
        WHEN 'Total structural variants' THEN 1
        WHEN 'Deletion' THEN 2
        WHEN 'Duplication' THEN 3
        WHEN 'Insertion' THEN 4
        WHEN 'Inversion' THEN 5
        WHEN 'Structural variants > 50 bp' THEN 6
        ELSE 99
    END;

name: KIDS First OFC SVs overlapping gene body ±5kb
description: Returns phenotype_svs rows where the SV overlaps any gene body with a 5kb margin. This is intended as a downloadable filtered phenotype_svs-style CSV.
query: SELECT DISTINCT ps.sample, ps.id, ps.type, ps.chrom, ps.start, ps."end", ps.length, ps.likelihood, ps.methods, ps.freq, ps.pheno, ps.gender FROM phenotype_svs ps WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM genes g WHERE g.chrom = ps.chrom AND ps.start <= CAST(g.x2 AS INTEGER) + 5000 AND ps."end" >= CAST(g.x1 AS INTEGER) - 5000) ORDER BY ps.chrom, ps.start, ps."end", ps.sample, ps.id

name: KIDS First OFC SVs overlapping exon regions ±5bp
description: Returns phenotype_svs rows where the SV overlaps any merged exon region with a 5bp margin. This is intended as a downloadable filtered phenotype_svs-style CSV.
query: SELECT DISTINCT ps.sample, ps.id, ps.type, ps.chrom, ps.start, ps."end", ps.length, ps.likelihood, ps.methods, ps.freq, ps.pheno, ps.gender FROM phenotype_svs ps WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM gene_exon_regions ger WHERE ger.chrom = ps.chrom AND ps.start <= CAST(ger.region_end AS INTEGER) + 5 AND ps."end" >= CAST(ger.region_start AS INTEGER) - 5) ORDER BY ps.chrom, ps.start, ps."end", ps.sample, ps.id
